title: AsyncEnvelope
description: TASK-717: the normative async task/event envelope. See docs/architecture/agentic-workflow-platform/async-contract.md for prose and per-transport delivery semantics. Copied byte-for-byte by both the TypeScript (@arcaai/async-contract) and Python (hope_async_contract) packages' parity tests -- this file is the single source of truth for the wire shape.

schemaVersion.description: Integer. A consumer MUST refuse an unknown value rather than best-effort parse (usage-outbox.payload.ts:18-22 precedent). This document defines version 1 only.

id.description: The envelope's own identity. UUIDv7, matching the platform's `@default(uuid(7))` convention -- sorts by creation time.

tenantId.description: MANDATORY, never null. Platform-wide messages use the SYSTEM tenant 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, never NULL (rule 02's 'NULL = global is banned', mirrored here).

type.description: Lowercase dotted event/task type, e.g. `stt.segment.finalized`, `smr.stream.chunk`. Deliberately NOT SysEventType's `SysEvent.ResourceCreated` form -- that is an EventEmitter2 channel name, not a wire type. 2 to 5 dot-separated segments.

occurredAt.description: When the FACT happened, in UTC -- never the publish/redelivery time. A redelivery of the same logical event MUST carry the original occurredAt.

correlationId.description: Request/session-scoped identifier, propagated unchanged across every envelope caused by the same request or session.

causationId.description: The `id` of the envelope that caused this one, or null when there is no known cause (e.g. the first envelope of a chain, or a producer that does not yet track causation -- see async-contract.md Adoption guidance). Optional in practice; most producers may emit null until they adopt it deliberately.

idempotencyKey.description: Intent-derived, never random (usageLedger/idempotency-keys.ts:3-26). Grammar reused verbatim from that module.

payload.description: Inline JSON document. Mutually exclusive with payloadRef -- exactly one of the two MUST be present.

payloadRef.description: Claim-check reference to an out-of-band blob. Mutually exclusive with payload. Shape is ClaimCheckRef verbatim (apps/harness/src/harness/temporal/claim_check.py:64-80).

store.description: Which BlobStore implementation wrote this ref, e.g. `s3`. Matches ClaimCheckRef.store.

key.description: Content-addressed object key within the bucket.

size.description: Byte size of the referenced blob.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the referenced blob. Verified by the consumer at resolve time -- a mismatch is a fail-loud integrity error, never a silent partial read.

contentType.description: camelCase on the wire; the Python model's `content_type` maps to it by pydantic alias.
